title: Sparkly snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='93' rx='40' ry='8' fill='#9ad4ff'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='19' fill='#f2fbff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='72' r='6' fill='#d6eefc'/>
  <!-- middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='15' fill='#f2fbff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='50' r='5' fill='#d6eefc'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='11' fill='#f2fbff'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='29' r='4' fill='#d6eefc'/>

  <rect x='39' y='17' width='22' height='5' rx='2' fill='#ff5a7a'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='1.8' fill='#3b3f6e'/>
  <!-- stick arms -->
  <path d='M36 50 L24 42 M27 46 L23 47' stroke='#b5763a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M64 50 L76 42 M73 46 L77 47' stroke='#b5763a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
